items.title: Prosecutor declines to charge a police officer who fatally shot a Black man in Wisconsin
items.brief: The Wisconsin police officer who shot and killed a 38-year-old Black man in Madison in July acted reasonably and will not face criminal charges, a prosecutor announced Thursday, drawing immediate condemnation from…

items.title: Trump, Putin, Xi nukes statement echoes Reagan and Gorbachev — but will their actions?
items.brief: The historic three-way summit between US President Donald Trump, Chinese leader Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin this week may have yielded little immediate diplomatic progress .

items.brief: Anthropic’s stock market debut turned the vast majority of the young startup’s staff into overnight millionaires — some many times over.

items.title: The world is experiencing ‘GTA VI’ together — players and spectators alike
items.brief: Millions of people around the world are playing “Grand Theft Auto VI.” Millions more are watching other people play it.

items.title: Iranian operative accused of directing failed terror plot at base US operates declares innocence and wants new lawyers
items.brief: The man accused of plotting to blow up a UK airbase where the US military operates was led out of a courtroom Thursday while shouting in Arabic after a nearly two-hour hearing devolved.

items.title: Globally adored hippo Fiona dies after eating a visitor’s hat at Cincinnati Zoo
items.brief: Fiona, the universally loved and internationally famous hippopotamus at Cincinnati Zoo, has died at age 9 after ingesting a knit hat that accidentally landed in her habitat, the zoo announced.

items.title: Anthropic passed the IPO test. Now comes the hard part.
items.brief: If Anthropic’s first day of trading was a test, it would have passed with flying colors.

items.title: Florida being pummeled by developing storm that could snarl early Thanksgiving travel on the East Coast
items.brief: A rare high risk of flooding is in effect for parts of Florida’s Space Coast through Friday as a dayslong torrential rain event inundates the state’s Atlantic coast, flooding homes and prompting dozens of water rescues.
